key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a unified European drone industrial policy linking the Drone Strategy 2.0 with the European Defence Industrial Strategy.
Recommends the drone sector as a pilot for tailor-made public support, joint procurement and subsidies, possibly an 'Airbus of drones'.
Supports a Drone Technology Roadmap and harmonised dual-use civil-military R&D, certification and standards (EASA alignment).
Calls for training, education and public-trust initiatives for responsible drone use, plus a common counter-drone strategy.
Stresses a regulatory framework with judicial oversight so drones do not threaten democratic rights.
annotation.summary_en: European Economic and Social Committee opinion using the drone manufacturing sector as a case study for European strategic autonomy. It urges a unified industrial policy, civil-military dual-use synergies, joint procurement, subsidies, harmonised certification and standards, training and public trust, a counter-drone strategy, and a regulatory framework protecting democratic rights.
annotation.title_clean: Drone manufacturing industry: a case study to assess the outcome in a strategic sector of the different policies in place to enhance European strategic autonomy
